summary: Phase 36 (LNMO Central Library + Kerala SCERT templates) end-to-end testing. Backend: all 7 pytest tests in tests/test_phase36.py PASS (large-file 45MB upload + background extraction, >60MB rejection, template seed, non-platform 403, pending→approved import+badge, material-import-requires-chapter, school-submit→platform-approve). Frontend: platform /platform/library loads with all data-testids (platform-library, lib-tab-library, lib-tab-templates, lib-up-grade/-type, lib-filter-grade/-status); upload WITHOUT file (grade Grade 8, subject Mathematics, type textbook, title 'QA Test TB …') succeeds and appears as published; grade+status filter works. Chapter templates tab shows both seeded templates (Grade 8 · Basic Science (18 chapters) and Grade 8 · Mathematics (10 chapters)); Edit → Save shows 'Template saved' toast. Teacher wizard Create curriculum on Grade 10 Mathematics opens 3-step ai-create-dialog with all step/field testids; step-2 'Start from Kerala SCERT template' (ai-wiz-load-template) is present and gracefully toasts 'No Kerala SCERT template for Grade 10 Mathematics yet' when no template exists (G10 has none; G8 Mathematics seed verified via backend test). Contribute dialog on Grade 8 Mathematics shows 'Browse LNMO Library' panel (ai-library-browser) listing published items for the curriculum's grade+subject with Attach buttons (ai-library-attach-<id>); attaching the uploaded textbook returned toast 'QA Test TB 1791281938 attached — pending principal approval'. Curriculum detail drawer on Grade 8 Mathematics for the teacher shows 3 'Submit to LNMO Library' buttons (ai-item-submit-lib-<id>); clicking returned 'Submitted to LNMO Library — awaiting platform approval'. One critical runtime bug found and fixed in CurriculumDetail.jsx (missing Library icon import — 'Library is not defined' blew up ItemRow for every row with submit/lib-badge rendering).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED — missing `Library` icon import from lucide-react caused Uncaught ReferenceError: 'Library is not defined' when the detail drawer rendered any item (every row renders a Submit to LNMO Library button and/or LNMO Library badge). Entire drawer crashed for teacher + admin.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: visual-editor instrumentation injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> (React warns span cannot be child of option). No functional impact.

action_items: No action — critical Library import bug already patched by tester (CurriculumDetail.jsx line 2). Please verify the fix in next build and re-run yarn build to confirm no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: CurriculumDetail.jsx used Library icon in two places (ai-item-lib-badge, ai-item-submit-lib) without importing it — would have crashed every drawer open in production. Suggest adding a lint rule / lazy build check or icon-usage sanity test; this type of missing-import regression has shipped twice in the AI Tutor pages.

No visible delete affordance in UI for a platform library item (lib-delete-<id> testid exists per earlier probe), but a per-item delete button text is not surfaced on the current Published list card — verify delete action is still reachable from the UI (platform admin may need an inline × / Delete button in the row). Did not block the test case.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after Library-import fix (all Phase 36 UI testids verified live)

rca of the issue: CurriculumDetail.jsx added two new usages of the `<Library>` lucide icon (badge + submit button in ItemRow) but did not update the top-level named import list `import { ... } from 'lucide-react'`. React threw ReferenceError on first render of any ItemRow. Fix: added `Library` to the named-imports list on line 2.
